summary: Human stature by age is open but cross-sectional (NHANES, CDC growth charts); individual longitudinal series through puberty exist only in small classical cohorts (Berkeley Growth Study via the R fda package, not verified here). For metamorphosis, Add-my-Pet holds literature age-size series for some amphibians and insects and Dryad has lab Manduca growth data, but no repository dataset carries a size series across the metamorphic transition with independently dated epochs for several species.
next_step: Assemble a small multi-species table: AmP tL/tW series for 3–5 metamorphosing species with their recorded metamorphosis ages, plus one longitudinal human height cohort with peak-height-velocity age; then pre-register a segmented-regression test.
obstacles_confirmed: Comparable longitudinal mass or size series are sparse outside model species.
Metamorphic growth series are not gathered as a single designed dataset.
